body.name: Ci
body.def: For nonactual \(s\in R(P_{i-1})\) and \(t\in R(P_i)\), \(C_i(s,t)\) is the minimum of \(\sum_{q\in D_i(b)}c(q\to P_i)\) over rows \((s,b)\) with \(t\in A_{P_i}(s,b)\) and \(\operatorname{Safe}_i(D_i(b))\), where \(D_i(b)=\{q\in W_i:b_q\ne a_q\}\); the empty minimum is \(+\infty\).
